directAnswer: Start by checking the domain's registration status and DNS settings. Use tools like WHOIS and DNS lookup to identify issues.
summary: Troubleshooting a domain name involves verifying its registration, DNS settings, and potential propagation issues.

sections.heading: Check Domain Registration
sections.body: Use a WHOIS lookup tool to verify if the domain is registered and check the expiration date. If the domain is expired, you may need to renew it.

sections.heading: Verify DNS Settings
sections.body: Access your domain registrar's dashboard to ensure DNS records are correctly configured. Common records to check include A, CNAME, and MX records.

sections.heading: Check for Propagation Issues
sections.body: After making changes to DNS settings, it can take up to 48 hours for changes to propagate globally. Use online tools to check DNS propagation status.

steps.title: Perform a WHOIS Lookup
steps.detail: Visit a WHOIS lookup website, enter your domain name, and check its registration status and expiration date.

steps.title: Access DNS Settings
steps.detail: Log in to your domain registrar account, navigate to the DNS management section, and review your DNS records for accuracy.

steps.title: Check DNS Propagation
steps.detail: Use a DNS propagation checker tool to see if your DNS changes have propagated across different regions.

faqs.question: What should I do if my domain is expired?
faqs.answer: You will need to renew your domain through your registrar's website to regain access.

faqs.question: How can I reset my DNS settings?
faqs.answer: You can reset your DNS settings by logging into your registrar account and restoring default DNS settings or manually re-entering correct values.

faqs.question: Why is my website still down after changing DNS settings?
faqs.answer: It may take time for DNS changes to propagate. If it's been over 48 hours, check for errors in your DNS configuration.

caveats: DNS changes can take time to propagate, and results may vary based on the DNS cache of different ISPs.
